paraphrase: I withered, withered and suffered in my mind; I was caught in the great sorrow of birth, running after young women and their pleasures; then I searched, searched, and found for myself — the name 'Nārāyaṇa'.
speaker: Tirumaṅkai Āḻvār
notes: 'vāṭiṉēṉ vāṭi varuntiṉēṉ ... nāṭiṉēṉ nāṭi nāṉ kaṇṭu koṇṭēṉ nārāyaṇā eṉṉum nāmam'.

paraphrase: It gives good family, gives wealth, levels to the ground the sufferings of devotees, gives the heavenly world, gives grace and strength and every other good, and does more good than a mother who bore one — I have found the name 'Nārāyaṇa'.
speaker: Tirumaṅkai Āḻvār
